thread:
Zoe: Morning—sun's been a weapon today. glare off my external monitor makes text unreadable during 9-11am. curious what y'all do? blinds aren't an option (landlord). :sun_with_face:
Anya: blackout curtains? landlord won't allow? I've used poster board clipped to the window frame as a temporary shade. ugly but works. :card_file_box:
Marcus: cheap screen hood works well. I cut a cardboard box into a U-shape and tape it to monitor edges. reduces glare and looks... DIY. :package:
Hugo: polarizing sunglasses? kidding. but seriously a matte screen protector cuts reflections. easy to stick on, ~$10.
Zoe: I don't want to tape the monitor. any less-perm options? also worried about heat if I block airflow.
Anya: use a clamp-on monitor visor (search "monitor shade"). non-invasive, clamps to back and drops over top. thriftier: rubber shelf liners + binder clips shaped into a visor.
Marcus: if you have a second cheap monitor, angle it as a shield in front of the main one (makes the desk weird). I've done the binder clip + neoprene mousepad trick.
Hugo: ops-bot: FYI building maintenance doing window seal checks 10:00-12:00 local. might let you ask the landlord for a curtain fix.
ops-bot: heads-up: building maintenance window checks scheduled 10:00-12:00 local. contact building@housing for permission requests. :calendar:
Zoe: haha binder-clip visor, here we go. trying the matte protector first. will post a picture of the cardboard hood if it becomes a landmark. :camera_with_flash:
Anya: post it. this channel lives for horrendous desk hacks. :popcorn:
